one_line: AI industry sees record funding, Anthropic's valuation falls, DeepMind releases Genie 4, Apple adds AI to iWork.

themes.title: AI sector sees massive funding
themes.text: Disruptive closed a $10 billion fund for AI, defense and software startups, and Meta’s $25 billion share offering was oversubscribed fivefold as it seeks up to $98 billion for AI. AMD pledged $1 billion, Nvidia $3 billion to Meta’s equity, Nvidia also led a $14 million round for Simplismart, and TPG is negotiating a $5 billion acquisition of Ark Data Centres.

stories.headline: Disruptive raises $10 billion fund to back AI, defense and software startups
Meta’s $25 billion share sale oversubscribed fivefold as it seeks $98 billion for AI
AMD to invest $1 billion in Meta equity offering and install Helios rackscale systems
Nvidia to invest $3 billion as Meta expands Vera Rubin CPU deployment for Muse AI agents
Nvidia backs Indian startup Simplismart with $14 million to cut AI GPU costs
General Compute raises $100 million Series A at $800 million valuation
TPG in talks to acquire UK‑based Ark Data Centres for about $5 billion

themes.title: Anthropic valuation drops, margins rise
themes.text: Anthropic filed for a Nasdaq IPO with a valuation around $1.5 trillion after growth slowed, while its S‑1 filing shows an 85% gross margin for the first half of the year from model services.

stories.headline: Anthropic’s IPO faces valuation drop as growth slows and AI prices plunge
Anthropic reports 85% gross margin in H1 from model services

themes.title: DeepMind releases Genie 4 model
themes.text: Google DeepMind made its Genie 4 world model available as a research preview, enabling photorealistic, interactive 3‑D simulations with real‑time audio and text‑prompted scene editing for up to two minutes.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model in research preview
Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model in research preview

themes.title: Apple adds AI to iWork
themes.text: Apple introduced an AI‑powered iWork Intelligent Assistant in Pages, Keynote and Numbers, built on Apple and OpenAI models, currently in beta for Creator Studio subscribers on iOS 27, iPadOS 27 and macOS 27.

stories.headline: Apple adds AI assistant to Pages, Keynote and Numbers
